note: Western Sahara: entry to the Moroccan-administered parts is controlled by Morocco's border authorities under Morocco's rules (the ma list), Moroccan citizens entering freely; independent travellers may be turned back (not modelled). The Polisario-held zone east of the berm isn't reached through a border the game models.

sources.title: UK Foreign, Commonwealth & Development Office, Western Sahara travel advice: Entry requirements
sources.said: You can travel without a visa for visits to the Moroccan-administered parts of Western Sahara and Morocco for up to 90 days. ... When first arriving in Morocco/Western Sahara, make sure you get a passport stamp from the Moroccan border control authorities.
